problem.fact: The current CMPNXBR3 duplicated-metadata recovery grammar has an optimistic Boundary floor of 73454 B, already 357 B larger than the unchanged 73097 B solid-Zstd-19 control.
problem.constraint: A positive coordered semantic court therefore cannot advance Boundary by wrapping the current recovery grammar unchanged.

mechanism.self_indexing: Each bounded-drift EditProgram begins with a record_count and then exactly that many copy/delete/insert-length/literal records. Program boundaries are therefore derivable by a bounded sequential scan of the authenticated patch stream; program_offset and program_length need not be duplicated recovery authority.
mechanism.open_identity: Keep logical_size plus SHA-256 per content-ordered regular member so filesystem identity can be established during open/list without decoding the shared patch.
mechanism.recovery_ownership: Store the filesystem-semantic open bundle once. Duplicate only the smallest authenticated locator/index needed for primary-from-tail and tail-from-primary recovery. Payload corruption still fails closed; recovery protects metadata authority, not arbitrary damaged content.

why_this_is_not_product_credit: No exact recovery framing bytes have been materialized in current v0.31.

No cold-open/list, read, verify, RSS, temporary-I/O, native, Android or portability evidence exists for this shape.
